points.text: The linked article reports that Take-Two’s DMCA takedown disabled Leonida and 3,007 forks.
The linked article reports that GTA VI’s shaders start loading on omonkey’s build, streamed live on Rumble.
The tracker records that DumbFloridaMoron joined the board, claiming the stage "Runnable".

sentences.text: The linked article reports that Take-Two filed a DMCA notice against Leonida, claiming it breaches Rockstar’s reverse-engineering ban.
The linked article says that GitHub applied the notice to 3,007 forks, making them unavailable.
The linked article states that Leonida’s Discord server disappeared, with members saying Discord banned it.
The linked article says private builds now play through Lucia’s prologue and into Jason’s first mission, though most still render badly.
Yahoo Tech reports that GTA VI reportedly boots on PC hours after a leaked Xbox build’s executable surfaces.
Instant Gaming News reports that unofficial GTA VI PC ports are still in development despite Take-Two’s efforts to shut them down.

xbox2windows.summary: Xbox2Windows's recent commits and pull requests mention unsigned RGBA8 vertex fetches, scalar constants, XMem page leases, mesh pipeline caching, AVX integer forms and audio activity counting.

palmetto.summary: Palmetto's recent commits mention profiling boot compilation time, completing status arrays, adding sampler windows diagnostics, keeping reverse-engineering workflow outside repo, and repairing docs anchors.

vitoriabr.summary: Uilian's recent commits and pull requests mention merged branches, first-room rendering, on-demand levels, CPU FPS optimization, packed dot products and console texture formats.

victory-gta6.summary: hyphennn's recent commits mention frame rate improvements, submit thread, copy queue, and pull requests claim GPU skip heap pages and a dedicated D3D12 copy queue.

tuxbox.summary: TuxBox's commits mention merging pull requests, accepting sampler heap base in xshader, and listing memory slots, while pull requests claim adding DXC and writable 16-bit depth.

openscarlett-ce.summary: OpenScarlett (Community Edition)'s recent commits mention table and heap memory reads, undecodable view slots, mesh loop barriers, placed buffers, compute step limits and texture-to-buffer copies.

dumbfloridamoron.summary: DumbFloridaMoron's recent commits mention binding time, upload and texture rings, a readable memo, heap budgeting, fxceless frame-rate work and packed textures.

xcl.summary: XCL's recent commits mention merging sampler anisotropy, texture state skipping, D3D12X binds skipping, DXIL RC, UAV companion SRV, and GPU handle signal fixes.

belobug.summary: Belobug's recent commits mention a README explaining the fork, swapping shader containers with files, reading pixel quads, running hoisted clamps, and replacing indirect diffuse light.
